description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific agricultural trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper), which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance, making it a public service administrative matter rather than a government structural/personnel change or any of the other specialized categories.
